title: Draw on an unlocked layer, lock it, and verify drawing is blocked until unlocked
goal: A pixel painted on a new layer appears over Bun; once that layer is locked, painting changes nothing and adds no Undo step; after unlocking, painting works again and one Undo removes only the newest stroke.
cliOnly: pixels at (0,0) and (1,0) placed by coordinate and per-layer native RGBA

steps.why: The new, empty layer is active and changes nothing visible.
The blue pixel covers Bun's centre pixel on the new layer.
The layer shows it is locked.
The locked layer refused the stroke.
The refused stroke added no Undo step: one Undo reverses the lock itself.
The blue pixel is still there.
After unlocking, the red stroke lands.
Undo removes only the post-unlock stroke.
